what.title: What is Ichi?
what.body: Ichi is a place where you can browse listings published by individuals, teams, and organizations for activities and participant recruitment.

steps.step1: Check the contents of the listings and find activities or recruitment that suit you
steps.step2: Open a listing that interests you and proceed to apply or create a listing

search.title: Filtered Search
search.body: You can narrow down results by prefecture, city, genre, poster, and keyword.

steps.step1: Select a prefecture, then select a city
steps.step2: Set the genre, poster, and free-text keyword
steps.step3: Choose to sort by nearest or furthest deadline
steps.step4: Press the search button to display matching listings
steps.step5: Filter conditions are saved in the URL, so you can share or bookmark them via a link

apply.title: Respond to a Listing (Apply)
apply.body: Click a listing that interests you to review its details, then apply to OPEN listings. You need to be logged in to apply.

steps.step1: Click a listing in the list to open its detail page
steps.step2: Check the date and time, venue, application deadline, capacity, and area
steps.step3: For team recruitment, select the team that will apply and press "Respond to listing". You cannot apply again to a listing you have already applied to

personal_create.title: Publish a Personal Listing from a Draft
personal_create.body: A personal listing is first created as a private draft, and published after you edit its contents.

steps.step1: Enter the required details in My Ichi and create a draft
steps.step2: Check and edit the title, date and time, and the required venue
steps.step3: Choose the visibility, review the contents, and publish

visibility.title: Visibility and Display Name
visibility.body: For personal listings you can choose the visibility. Drafts are not published.

steps.step1: Members of your teams and organizations see your registered real name
steps.step3: Use public, public to selected teams and organizations, and private drafts as needed

team_organization.title: Creating Team/Organization Listings and Managing Applicants
team_organization.body: Creating listings for a team or organization and managing applicants requires management permission for that team or organization.

steps.step1: Create a listing from the team or organization screen
steps.step2: After publishing, review applicants and manage participation status as needed

cancellation.title: Confirmation and Cancellation
cancellation.body: You can check whether a listing has been confirmed, and cancel listings you no longer need.

steps.step1: Check the applications and capacity, and take the actions required for confirmation
steps.step2: Cancelling a published listing affects applicants, so review the contents before proceeding
